gaps.explanation: The budgetary comparison schedules count the sale of surplus as Local receipts, while the governmental funds statement (p5) prints 'Sale of surplus' under other financing sources (General 6,510 + Road 17,455 = Total 23,965, p5-6), not in total receipts 10,744,154. General Fund budget schedule (p11) Local 1,071,626 = combining General Fund column Local 1,065,116 (p7) + 6,510 (detail holds it as 1,065,116 + 'Local (Sale of surplus)' 6,510, split_from p11); Road Fund budget schedule (p13) Local 39,438 = statement Road Local 21,983 (p5) + 17,455. 6,510 + 17,455 = 23,965 = 10,768,119 - 10,744,154. Both printed totals are correct on their own basis; nothing missing or duplicated.

Statement p5-6 Transfers - in: Road 1,100,000 + Road and Bridge 500,000 + Non-Major 150,000 = 1,750,000; the General Fund column nets its sub-fund transfers (in 0, out (1,250,000)). The combining General Fund statement (p7-8) prints them gross: Self-Health Insurance 112,219 + Noxious Weed 49,967 = 162,186 in, General transfers out (1,412,186) (also budget schedule p12). Detail (gross per fund): 112,219 + 49,967 + 1,100,000 + 500,000 + 150,000 = 1,912,186 = 1,750,000 + 162,186.

Statement p5 Transfers - out: General (1,250,000) + Road (500,000) = (1,750,000). Detail: General (1,412,186) (budget schedule p12 / combining p7, gross incl. 162,186 to the Self-Health Insurance and Noxious Weed sub-funds) + Road (500,000) (p13) = 1,912,186; difference 162,186 = the sub-fund transfers in. No fix.
